integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photoreal with subtle CG creature detail, a vertical 9:16 high-angle wide shot begins exactly as Picture 1 with the girl's body curled in mid-air above a moss-covered prehistoric forest floor, her pink dinosaur backpack on her back. The camera tracks down with large amplitude at fast speed, holding her centered as she falls between drifting haze and thin shafts of daylight, giant ferns and towering conifers rising around her. She hits the thick moss with a soft bounce, leaves a shallow dent, and moss flakes drift down around her. The camera slows and pushes in with small amplitude as she braces on her hands, sits back on the moss, and tilts her face up toward the light, her pigtails settling, matching the pose, framing, and lighting of Picture 2 at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Wind rushes past the falling body before a muffled thud lands on soft moss. Loose moss and leaves patter down afterward, while insects and distant animal calls fill the humid forest air.

non_diegetic_music: A bright hand-drum and pizzicato-string adventure figure at a moderate tempo, easing in volume at the end.
